ground_truth_draft.expected_behavior: Under arbitrary_precision, deserialize_any must accept f64 values whose stored string was produced by ryu (used during serialization), not only by f.to_string(). The equality check is widened to accept either formatter, so adjacently tagged f32 values round-trip through visit_f64 instead of falling through to the map path.
ground_truth_draft.rationale_from_pr_metadata: Title 'Fix adjacently tagged f32 roundtrip regression' and body 'Fixes #520'. The one-line code change in src/number.rs adds `ryu::Buffer::new().format(f) == self.n ||` before the existing `f.to_string() == self.n` check inside `#[cfg(feature = "arbitrary_precision")] deserialize_any`. New regression test issue520.rs round-trips `E::Float(159.1)` through an adjacently tagged enum, confirming the bug was a stricter-than-needed format-equality precondition.
